主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. (IMPAC MORTGAGE HOLDINGS INC) suspended all lending activity for two weeks starting March 30, 2020, due to liquidity constraints and de-risking mandates from capital market counterparties. The decision followed uncertainty from a whole loan investor’s lack of communication and potential breach of its purchase commitment. The Company closed its TBA hedge position on March 18, 2020, collecting full net margin from TBA counterparties. It has not used the TBA market for hedging since then. The Company expects its capital market counterparties to fulfill obligations under contracts related to warehouse and repurchase funding, and forward sale of loans. If any counterparty fails, the Company will pursue remedies including specific performance and damages. The novel coronavirus outbreak continues to have a real-time impact on all business sectors. The company has volunteered to cover employees' health and medical benefits during the furlough period. The rapid development and fluidity of the effects of the coronavirus precludes any prediction as to the ultimate adverse impact on its business.
